VHL._status: ACTIVE ("enabled": true). All 131 pLDDT CSVs and the structure-metrics outputs are present. The strict canonical structural cohort contains 124 variants (105 driver / 19 passenger); six of the 130 mutant artifacts are excluded because their ClinVar aliases lack a target-gene NM-transcript protein substitution.
VHL._data_history: The initial copy was CORRUPT: 12 of 131 archives were not gzip at all (interrupted NTFS copy - they began mid-file with CIF headers, raw CSV, INDX blocks or JSON), alphabetically consecutive D121V..E53K plus - fatally - WT, with no valid WT there was no D1/RMSF/RMSD reference. Re-copied 2026-08-09 18:58 and re-verified: all 12 now fully decompress to 5.37 GB each, matching the known-good files. NTFS on macOS is read-only, so a repeat needs chkdsk on Windows or a fresh copy - and verify with full decompression, not just the gzip magic bytes (the failure mode leaves file size and mtime intact while the cluster mapping points elsewhere).
VHL._timings: pLDDT extraction 1 h 32 m (131 complex archives, ~0.22 s/CIF x 126 models); rmsf ~2.6 h. Budget for that if VHL is ever regenerated.
VHL._labels_ok: The shared labels.py loader now uses target-gene transcript matching for VHL. The strict canonical cohort retains 124 of 130 structural mutants: 105 driver / 19 passenger. Six permissive historical aliases are excluded because the source record has no VHL NM-transcript protein substitution.
VHL._chains: AlphaFold3 CRL2^VHL complex, 2122 residues over 6 chains, identified by residue count: A=VHL 213 (pVHL30, the mutated protein), B=Elongin B 118, C=Elongin C 112, D=Cullin-2 745, E=RBX1 108, F=HIF-1a 826 (the substrate). chain_ids/protein_chains stay ['A'] ON PURPOSE: chain_ids drives pLDDT extraction, so including B-F would average D1 over 1909 unmutated partner residues (VHL is only 10% of the model), diluting the mutation signal ~10x and breaking comparability with the other proteins - where chain_ids is likewise only the mutated protein (TP53 A-D are four copies of TP53; MutS_alpha A,B are MSH2+MSH6). The partners instead feed partner_chains for interface RMSF, which is the biologically right place for them: VHL is a substrate-recognition subunit and its pathogenic mutations act by disrupting HIF (F) and Elongin C (C) binding. There is no DNA, so dna_chains is intentionally absent and the protein-DNA stage correctly skips.
VHL._interface_preflight: Verified 2026-08-11 against the persisted aligned WT reference (structure_metrics/VHL/rmsf/global_wt_reference.pdb) BEFORE committing to the ~2.6 h rmsf re-run: partner_chains ['B','C','D','E','F'] yields 68 of VHL's 213 residues at an interface (32%), contacting F/HIF-1a 34, C/Elongin C 21, D/Cullin-2 7, B/Elongin B 6. The residue set (67-145 then 152-188) matches VHL's known domain layout - beta-domain binds HIF, alpha-domain binds Elongin C - which independently corroborates the chain assignment. Note extract_chain_interface_residues is symmetric (it runs both A->B and B->A), so the raw table has 147 rows: 68 VHL-side plus 79 partner-side. Only the VHL-side rows match VHL's RMSF data, which is keyed on (chain, resid). Existing DNA proteins show the same two-direction shape (POLE: 30 + 12), so this is the normal output format, not a VHL quirk.

PTEN._status: ACTIVE ("enabled": true). PTEN pLDDT CSVs and structure-metrics outputs are present. The strict canonical structural cohort contains 257 variants (248 driver / 9 passenger); five residue-1 start-loss models are excluded, and F81L remains unlabelled because its ClinVar record was retired.
PTEN._data: 264 archives in $DRIFT_ARCHIVE_ROOT/PTEN = 263 mutants + WT, ALL verified by full gzip decompression (0 corrupt, each ~0.23 GB uncompressed, 202 s for the sweep). Two disjoint generation batches: 128 on 2026-08-09 (127 mutants + WT) and 136 on 2026-08-11. No overlap.
PTEN._labels: The transcript-matched strict cohort contains 248 driver / 9 passenger variants. The 9 passengers - A79T, D107N, P354Q, P354S, Q298E, R161K, S229T, S294R, S360G - are canonical PTEN missense benigns and all came from the 08-11 batch; the 08-09 batch had none. Five initiator-codon models (M1I, M1L, M1R, M1T, M1V) are excluded because a full-length residue-1 substitution does not represent start loss. F81L is unlabelled: it was generated when ClinVar listed it Pathogenic (VariationID 1802604), but that record has since been retired and is absent from the archived export.
PTEN._caveats: Class balance is approximately 27.6:1 (248:9), i.e. ~1.8 passengers per fold under 5-fold CV, so treat per-gene AUC as directional and always quote uncertainty. ClinVar's ceiling is 44 canonical-missense benign codes total and only these 9 map to structures, so generating more drivers cannot improve minority-class power. A functional/DMS source remains the route to a properly powered PTEN cohort; ClinVar makes it usable, not strong.
PTEN._known_gap: RESOLVED for the canonical cohort: labels.py now filters ClinVar records by the target-gene NM transcript in Name, and the strict manifest excludes residue-1 start-loss models. Wrong-gene and wrong-isoform aliases from the permissive Protein change route are no longer analytical-cohort inputs.
